# LabelPro — India's First E-Commerce Label Studio
> Duplicate Remover • Label Cropper • Label Sorter • Buyer & Return Analyser

LabelPro (https://labelpro.in) is India's first intelligent e-commerce shipping label operating platform built specifically for Meesho, Flipkart, and Amazon marketplace sellers. It eliminates double-dispatch packaging losses, automates 4x6 thermal shipping label cropping, sorts warehouse batches by SKU/courier, and uncovers district-level buyer repeat demand.

## Primary Modules & Direct Sitelinks
1. **Duplicate Label Remover** (`https://labelpro.in/remove-duplicate`):
   - Cross-batch shipping label PDF comparator.
   - Compares two PDF label batches or scans internal order repetitions within a single PDF.
   - Eliminates duplicate order numbers instantly in browser memory before labels are printed.
   - Prevents double-shipping financial losses, courier penalty charges, and duplicate packaging waste.
   - Seamless 1-click handoff to Thermal Studio with zero blank pages.

2. **Thermal Label Studio & QR Stamper** (`https://labelpro.in/`):
   - Instant 4x6 thermal cropping preset for Meesho, Flipkart & Amazon shipping labels.
   - Client-side dynamic QR code stamper (WhatsApp reorder links, Instagram boosters, branded review cards).
   - High-definition badge styling with localized thank-you greetings across 8 Indian languages.
   - 100% vector PDF preservation with crystal-clear courier barcodes and AWB lines.

3. **Smart Batch SKU & Courier Sorter**:
   - 1-click automatic sorting by SKU Code (group identical products together for lightning-fast warehouse packing).
   - Sort by Order Date, Order Number, Quantity, or Customer Delivery Location.

4. **Customer Intelligence & District Demand Analyser** (`https://labelpro.in/customer-analysis`):
   - Visual district demand heatmap across Indian states and districts (*jile*).
   - Identifies high-performing sales hubs vs untapped regional markets.
   - Calculates customer retention rate and repeat buyer loyalty metrics.

5. **Reverse Logistics & RTO Return Manager** (`https://labelpro.in/returns`):
   - Upload marketplace return CSV reports to auto-match delivery addresses.
   - Separates genuine Customer Returns from Courier RTO (Return to Origin) undelivered packages.
   - Executive SKU Pause Matrix flags products with >20% return rates to prevent ongoing ad burn.

6. **QR Scan & Conversion Analytics** (`https://labelpro.in/analytics`):
   - Real-time conversion tracking for buyer engagement via package QR scans.
   - Identifies highest-converting product SKUs and repeat customer acquisition channels.

## Key Differentiators & Privacy Guarantee
- **100% Client-Side In-Browser Processing**: All PDF parsing, text extraction, duplicate filtering, and rendering occur inside client browser memory using WebAssembly & PDF-Lib. Sensitive customer names, phone numbers, and delivery addresses never leave the seller's computer.
- **Cross-Marketplace Compatibility**: Automatically recognizes label formats from Meesho, Flipkart (eKart, Instakart), and Amazon (ATS, Easy Ship).
- **Zero Cost & No Installation Required**: Accessible from any modern browser with instant download capabilities.
